name: MEE
summary: MEE, also known as 2-methoxy-4,5-diethoxyamphetamine or as TMA2-4,5-DiEtO, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families related to the psychedelic drug TMA-2. It is the analogue of TMA-2 in which the methoxy groups at the 4 and 5 positions have been replaced with ethoxy groups.6 mg orally and its duration as unknown. The drug produced no effects at tested doses.

fact.en: MEE is TMA-2 with two of its three methoxy groups swapped for larger ethoxy groups, one of a set of such variations that Shulgin described in PiHKAL.
fact.zh: MEE 是把 TMA-2 三個甲氧基中的兩個換成較大的乙氧基，屬於舒爾金在《PiHKAL》中描述的一系列這類變化之一。
fact.zhHans: MEE 是把 TMA-2 三个甲氧基中的两个换成较大的乙氧基，属于舒尔金在《PiHKAL》中描述的一系列这类变化之一。
